---
title: Architecture
---

A page two directories deep. Its `<link rel="stylesheet">` should
read `../../site_libs/quarto/quarto-theme-<hash>.css`.

The hash in the filename is content-derived: change the theme
config (e.g. `theme: cosmo` in `_quarto.yml`) and the hash flips,
but pages that don't change continue to point at *the same shared
file*. This makes the URL stable across rebuilds when the theme
hasn't changed.
